verdict.rationale: Pipecat's docs render a live Mintlify "Try it" playground for each Pipecat Cloud REST endpoint, with generated cURL examples and runnable in-page requests. This is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. The probe's 404s on root OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives under the REST reference path. missing for 10: interactive runnable reference for the Python framework API (only the Cloud REST API is shown), independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Pipecat Cloud REST reference renders a live "Try it" API playground per endpoint (the Mintlify api.playground runtime)
